mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stat_daily_user_order ( id, tenant_id, stat_date, user_id, order_count, paid_amount, last_payment_time, create_time, update_time ) SELECT REPLACE(UUID(), '-', ''), #{tenantId}, #{statDate}, user_id, COUNT(1), IFNULL(SUM(payment_price), 0), MAX(payment_time), NOW(), NOW() FROM order_info WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND del_flag = '0' AND pay_status = '1' AND payment_time >= #{startTime} AND payment_time < #{endTime} GROUP BY user_id ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE order_count = VALUES(order_count), paid_amount = VALUES(paid_amount), last_payment_time = VALUES(last_payment_time), update_time = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(stat_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS timePoint, IFNULL(SUM(paid_amount), 0) AS gmv, IFNULL(SUM(order_count), 0) AS payOrderCount, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS payBuyerCount FROM stat_daily_user_order WHERE stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY stat_date ORDER BY stat_date

SELECT IFNULL(SUM(paid_amount), 0) AS gmv, IFNULL(SUM(order_count), 0) AS orderCount, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS buyerCount FROM stat_daily_user_order WHERE stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}
